analysis_steps.goal: Extract spectra and moment maps of #A and #B

method.value: 1'' diameter aperture spectra, Gaussian model, collapse cube over f_cen±sigma_G, fit 2D Gaussian to maps, re-extract with FWHM ellipses

evidence.quote: We then estimate the spatial extent of the [CII]-emission arising from $\#A$ and $\#B$ by fitting a simple 2D Gaussian model to the velocity-integrated maps

fitting.value: 3-Gaussian modelling of #B spectrum to separate #C and #D

evidence.quote: The line properties of $\#B$, $\#C$ and $\#D$ (total flux, centroid and FWHM) are estimated from a 3-Gaussian modelling of the spectrum.

validation.value: 1'' aperture on [CII] peaks gives virtually unchanged results

evidence.quote: we tested a 1$''$-aperture centred on the [CII] peaks, and the results are virtually unchanged

analysis_steps.goal: Map total [CII] structure and PV diagrams

method.value: velocity-integrated map over [-500,+500] km/s about z_ref=4.570; PV diagrams along A-B axis and orthogonal

evidence.quote: we produce a velocity-integrated flux map by collapsing the spectral channels in the velocity range $[-500 : +500]$ km s$^{-1}$

method.value: compare spectrum within 1-sigma contour of total map with sum of the four galaxy spectra

evidence.quote: we extract a spectrum of the total [CII]-emitting system from a region within the 1-$\sigma$ contour of the velocity-integrated map

method.value: outflow timescale from Zanella2018 gas mass and Mdot_out~30; UV diffuse SFR vs L_[CII]-SFR relations

evidence.quote: we find that outflows would require at least $\sim$ 0.6 Gyr to expel the estimated amount of dense gas in the CGM

evidence.quote: (i) re-accretion does not occur, and (ii) both $\#A$ and $\#B$ have constantly had during their past growth a sufficient SFR

evidence.quote: We used three different calibrations, which give consistent results

findings_qualitative.value: [CII] structure of ~30 kpc diameter surrounds the system, with emission displaced >=10 kpc from UV/optical counterparts

evidence.quote: with a projected diameter of $\sim 30$ kpc

findings_qualitative.value: System lies at an overdensity peak of the protocluster PCl J1001+0220

evidence.quote: our merging system at $z\sim4.57$ is nearly coincident with the overdensity peak of the N-E sub-component

claims.hypothesis: Does the merging system host a large CGM [CII] envelope?
claims.experiment: Compared total [CII] spectrum with sum of galaxy spectra
claims.result: About 50% of L_[CII] lies between the components

evidence.quote: in a sort of circumgalactic and metal-rich gaseous *envelope* around the merging galaxies.

claims.hypothesis: Is the envelope from tidal stripping rather than outflows or faint satellites?
claims.experiment: Outflow timescale estimate and UV vs [CII]-based SFR comparison
claims.result: Outflows need >=0.6 Gyr; UV SFR ~10x lower than expected
claims.finding: Stripping dominates, with outflows and satellites contributing less

evidence.quote: we argue that most of the detected circumgalactic emission originates from the effect of gas stripping induced by strong gravitational interactions

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Outflows rejected as dominant: would need >=0.6 Gyr

evidence.quote: outflows might not be the dominant mechanism for injecting the large amount of circumgalactic cold gas observed in our system

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Faint satellites do not significantly account for the CGM [CII]

evidence.quote: small faint satellites do not significantly account for the detected large circumgalactic [CII] emission

limitations_admitted.value: Resolution insufficient to tell if the [CII] tail is a dusty star-forming region within #A or a dusty neighbour

evidence.quote: With the currently available ALMA resolution, it is unclear whether this [CII] tail is produced by a dust-obscured star-forming region within $\#A$

referee_caveats_inferred: Single short 20 min observation at ~1 arcsec resolution; CGM/galaxy split depends on aperture choices
Gas mass and outflow estimates are rough with no uncertainties
Stripping favoured by elimination, not directly tested; shocks not constrained
